title: Stewed, seasoned, ground beef with potatoes, Mexican style

content.title: About
content.content: Stewed, seasoned, ground beef with potatoes in Mexican style is a ready‑to‑eat product that combines minced beef, boiled potatoes and traditional Mexican spices (chili, cumin, paprika). The mixture is slowly stewed, resulting in tender meat and a rich, aromatic flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mexican cuisine often pairs beef and potatoes in dishes such as carne asada and papas fritas.
Low‑temperature stewing preserves most of the nutrients from both meat and potatoes.
The spice blend typically includes ancho (ground chili), giving the dish its characteristic heat and aroma.
The product is vacuum‑packed, extending shelf life without added preservatives.
Traditionally it is served with salsa, guacamole or fresh cilantro.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Beef provides a complete source of protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Rich in iron
items.content: Red meat contains highly bioavailable heme iron, supporting normal hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Potassium from potatoes
items.content: Potatoes supply potassium, which helps regulate fluid balance and blood pressure.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Both beef and potatoes contribute B12, B6 and niacin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidant spices
items.content: Cumin and paprika contain polyphenols that may have antioxidant effects.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Beef can contain saturated fats; individuals with high cholesterol should watch portion size.

items.title: Salt and spice level
items.content: The product may be salty and spicy; people with hypertension or spice sensitivity should adjust accordingly.

items.title: Spice allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chili or cumin.

items.title: Proper heating
items.content: Improper reheating can allow bacterial growth; heat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the product in a microwave or on the stovetop until steaming hot. Serve as a main dish, with rice, corn tortillas, or use as a filling for burritos. Add fresh salsa, guacamole or grated cheese to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store refrigerated at 0–4 °C in the original vacuum pack for up to 5 days after opening. It can be frozen at –18 °C for up to 3 months. Reheat thoroughly before consumption.
